# pvecli audit

Audit a cluster: certificates, access, firewall, versions, backups, snapshots, orphans.

Read only. Exit code 0 when nothing fails (warnings included), 2 when a
check fails, 1 when the audit could not run.

```text
pvecli audit [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `--cert-days N` | `30` | Warn on certificates expiring within this many days. |
| `--snapshot-age VALUE` | `30d` | Warn on snapshots older than this (30d, 2w). |
| `--backup-age VALUE` | `2d` | Warn on guests of a backup job whose last backup is older (2d, 36h). |
| `--skip-orphans` |  | Skip the orphan disk scan (lists every storage). |
| `--problems` |  | Hide OK lines. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile(s): name, list, pattern ('client-*') or @group. |
| `-js`, `--json` |  | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## Examples

```bash
pvecli audit
pvecli audit -p '*' --problems
pvecli audit -p @prod --json
```
